laws.rule: Souss-Massa National Park, zone I (the strict protection zone): entering, moving about, camping or scientific research is prohibited without the authorisation of the minister responsible for agriculture, apart from access to the localities of Tifnit, Sidi R'Bat and Sidi Ouassay. In zone II (traditional use zone), fires outside settlements are prohibited except by the means and in the places the park director authorises; litter may only be left in designated places; noisy instruments outside settlements, and writing or drawing on stones, trees or buildings, are prohibited. Off-road vehicle access in zone II is set by the park director.

Souss-Massa National Park: hunting, sea fishing and inland fishing are prohibited inside the park (sea fishing only at designated fishing and camping places in the marine zone). Harming wildlife or plants, polluting water, and disturbing wildlife by noise, throwing stones or any other means are prohibited. In zone II, cutting, uprooting or taking wild plants, bringing in non-domestic animals or their eggs, and bringing dogs except to designated places are prohibited.

Souss-Massa National Park: professional film, radio or television work that could disturb wildlife or damage plants is prohibited without the authorisation of the minister responsible for agriculture; apply in advance. Advertising of any kind is prohibited in the park.
